reason: The hypothesis relies on four key premises. The first two (uniform distribution via SPS, strength increase without strain loss) are directly supported by E3/E4 for an AZ91-HEA composite. The third premise (thermal conductivity increase) is entirely unsupported by any cited evidence, as none of the passages mention thermal conductivity. The fourth premise (transferability to W-Cu) is also unsupported, as the cited studies involve Mg- and Fe-based matrices, not W-Cu. Thus, the core claimed outcome lacks any prior evidence.
premises: HEA particles can be uniformly distributed in a metal matrix via SPS at 300°C
Adding 10 wt% HEA particles increases mechanical strength without reducing failure strain
